clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven forces hold Bael'dun Keep above the Bael Modan excavation in the southern Barrens. Under General Twinbraid, this imposing fortification anchors the Alliance's controversial presence in the region and brings it into violent conflict with the surrounding Horde territories.

Bael'dun Keep rises over the Bael Modan excavation as the fortified military heart of Ironforge's presence in the southern Barrens. Dwarven architect Haggis Boatmurder designed the stronghold to protect the Prospectors and archaeologists searching the trenches for ancient titan artifacts. Ironworks and artillery arm its garrison, which keeps a vigilant watch, secures dwarven supply lines, and projects Alliance military power into Kalimdor's heartland.

The keep and its adjoining digsite displaced the local Stonespire tribe of tauren from their ancestral home. Bael'dun remains a flashpoint in the Barrens, and nearby Horde outposts see it as a flagrant military intrusion. Gann Stonespire wages a personal war of vengeance against the invaders. Aggrieved tauren, opportunistic scouts, and suspicious outposts such as Camp Taurajo keep the fortress under threat of raids and sabotage.
